title: Heap OOM in non-interactive runs: ignore-matcher (path-scurry + minimatch) appears to be rebuilt per file, heap scales with files × .gitignore rules

triage_metadata.reasoning: The issue provides detailed reproduction steps, environment details, heap snapshot analysis, and pinpoints a memory leak/excessive allocations in file discovery and ignore matching.
triage_metadata.effort_reasoning: This is a performance and memory issue involving diagnosing and fixing massive heap memory leaks and excessive allocations during file discovery and gitignore pattern compilation on large repositories.

summary.problem: Non-interactive runs on repositories with many files and .gitignore rules cause JavaScript heap out of memory (OOM) due to excessive object allocations during file discovery and ignore matching.
summary.root_cause: GitIgnoreParser.isIgnored repeatedly instantiates new ignore() objects and re-adds/re-compiles gitignore and extra patterns for every directory level of every file evaluated during file discovery, allocating hundreds of thousands of _PathPosix and _Pattern objects.
summary.context: The issue manifests during headless file discovery across large monorepos with multiple .gitignore files, where minimatch pattern compilation and path-scurry walker creation scale with (files x ignore rules) instead of being cached once per root/directory.

steps: Refactor GitIgnoreParser in packages/core/src/utils/gitIgnoreParser.ts to cache and reuse compiled ignore matchers per directory instead of instantiating new ignore() instances on every isIgnored call.
Avoid re-compiling extra patterns and global patterns repeatedly by reusing pre-compiled ignore instances or memoizing cumulative ignore filters per directory path.
Update FileDiscoveryService in packages/core/src/services/fileDiscoveryService.ts if necessary to reuse ignore parser instances or pass down cached matchers during traversal.

testing_strategy.expected_behavior: GitIgnoreParser should correctly evaluate gitignore and extra ignore rules without creating redundant ignore instances or thrashing memory on large file sets.
verification_steps: Run unit tests in packages/core/src/utils/gitIgnoreParser.test.ts using Vitest.
Verify that gitignore matching correctness is maintained across nested directories and extra patterns.
Run file discovery tests in packages/core/src/services/fileDiscoveryService.test.ts to verify performance and correctness.
